title: DenseOpenRestrictionComparison
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field and P=(X,A) a curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting] with constructible torsion abelian sheaf A [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion]. Let U be a dense open of X, j its inclusion, and B=j_!j^*A [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Use the coefficient equivalence E from abelian groups to modules over ULift Z, defined by the inverse of the forgetful equivalence from Z-modules followed by restriction of scalars along ULift Z ≃ Z. Put F=E(A) and G=E(B). Write T(F) for the alternative that F has invertible-order torsion or is p-primary for a prime p=char(k) [def-weil-pbc-primary-torsion]. C8(F) is equivalent to C8(G), where C8 is surjectivity of degree-two cohomology restriction to every open immersion [def-weil-pbc-C8].

proof.text: Convert coefficients using exists_lowerShriek_coefficient_counit. Forget scalars on its isomorphism and counit equality. This gives e′.hom followed by the converted abelian counit equal to the module counit.

Apply dense_open_high_cohomology to the converted module sheaf. In degree two its counit map and every open-immersion pullback of it are bijective. Functoriality of H.map and the coefficient counit equality identify each with the converted abelian counit map composed with the map of the isomorphism e′. Mathlib's Sheaf.functorH maps e′ and its open pullback to isomorphisms of additive groups; Iso.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv supplies their bijective underlying maps. Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff cancels these maps, giving bijectivity of the exact counit used here globally and on every open.

For each open immersion a, cohomologyMap_map identifies the composite of restriction with the target counit map with the composite of the source counit map with restriction. Function.Surjective.of_comp_iff' cancels the bijective target counit map and Function.Surjective.of_comp_iff cancels the surjective source counit map. This gives equivalence of the two restriction surjectivity assertions. Quantifying over a proves the claimed iff. No additional helper declaration is needed.
